verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a TOTP authenticator app, so team sharing of TOTP logins is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack documents only per-user features: cloud backup to a personal Microsoft account, password export, and App Lock. Nothing shows shared vaults, collections, or per-member access control for sharing codes across a team.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
